# Firstreply

> AI automation agency in London, UK. We make every pound of ad spend traceable and get every lead a human-approved reply in under 60 seconds — built for education, catering and hospitality & events businesses running paid ads.

## Services

- Tracking Fix: server-side Meta Conversions API setup with event deduplication, GDPR-compliant (£800–£1,200 one-off)
- Speed-to-Lead System: every lead captured instantly, AI-drafted reply within 60 seconds with human approval gates, WhatsApp owner alerts, automated follow-up (£1,500–£2,500 setup + £250/month)
- Full Growth Engine: Facebook & Instagram lead generation campaigns, tracking, speed-to-lead and automated reporting (£1,000–£2,000/month, rolling)

## Key facts

- Founder: Golam Rabbani — MSc Computer Network & System Security (University of Hertfordshire), ex-Digital Marketing Manager with 5+ years of Facebook/Meta ads experience, n8n and Python automation specialist
- AI never messages customers without human approval — approval gates are built into every workflow
- GDPR-by-design pipelines; data processing agreement available; no long contracts
- Primary offer: free 15-minute "Lead Leak Audit" call
